title: Petal link v1
description: link/v1 (specs/005-mapping-brain/composition.md, section 2c): an Ethereum or Solana wallet proving, once, with its own signature, that it belongs to a NEAR profile. The wallet signs a text whose statement names both and this document's hash without its proof: 'Petals: <wallet> belongs to <near account>. Link <hash>'. It goes public as a layer of the profile's own publication about its own account, so the profile's NEAR signature covers it too; anyone checks the wallet's signature over its text, and the profile's over the publication. A link only one side has signed credits nothing. Unlinking is the profile's next version about its own account without it.

profile.description: the NEAR account the wallet belongs to, CAIP-10

wallet.description: the linked wallet, CAIP-10: eip155:1:0x… (one for every EVM chain, lower case) or solana:<genesis>:<base58>

linked_at.description: when the server prepared the link, the signed text's own issued-at

message.description: the text the wallet signed, whose statement names this link
